Header.title: Reza Salehi
Header.paragraph: Full-stack specialist with a strong frontend focus—building polished web and app experiences, plus AI-powered product features.

About.paragraph: Self-taught full-stack web and mobile developer with {{years}} years of professional experience across product companies and remote teams. Strong frontend skills in React, Vue, and Angular, plus backend delivery with Node.js, NestJS, Django, and Flask. Hands-on with AI engineering—RAG, LLM integration, vector databases, AI agents, prompt engineering, LangChain/LangGraph, and embeddings. Excellent teamwork, communication, and timeline ownership—passionate about learning and new opportunities.

highlights: Led senior full-stack delivery for Boxy’s merchant logistics platform across web, Android, and iOS—owning features from API design through React/Vue/Nuxt.js and React Native client release.

Spearheaded unified merchant workflows across responsive web and mobile applications (React, Vue, Nuxt.js, React Native, NestJS, Django), accelerating cross-client release velocity from 3 weeks down to 9 days.

Built and maintained shared merchant surfaces and product modules across React, Vue, and Nuxt.js apps under one roadmap, keeping web and mobile feature parity for shipping, tracking, and order operations.
Refactored high-concurrency order dispatch and payment processing pipelines, achieving a 38% reduction in API response latency and maintaining 99.95% transaction success during peak traffic.
Architected a multi-brand component design system and unified state management with Zustand and RTK Query, ensuring synchronized real-time data across 3 separate merchant touchpoints.
Hardened NestJS and Django services with PostgreSQL and Redis for high-throughput shipping and payment flows, improving reliability for merchants running daily delivery operations at scale.

Owned end-to-end full-stack delivery across 5 business verticals—live audio/video streaming, interactive collaboration suites, dashboards, and supporting APIs—shipping in Agile/Scrum sprints with backlog grooming, demos, and iterative releases.
Built high-availability React, Vue, and Angular client applications with TypeScript, shared design patterns, and reusable UI modules that accelerated feature rollout across multiple product lines.
Constructed asynchronous microservices with Node.js, NestJS, and Redis pub/sub queues, sustaining 100k+ concurrent WebSocket connections with zero downtime under production load.
Integrated WebRTC media pipelines into responsive enterprise dashboards, cutting packet loss and audio latency by 22% for distributed video rooms and real-time collaboration sessions.

Hardened backend services with Django and NestJS REST/WebSocket APIs, Dockerized deployments, and monitoring-friendly service boundaries that improved release reliability across multi-team product streams.
Partnered with product and QA in cross-functional Agile ceremonies to prioritize roadmap work, reduce production incidents, and keep multi-vertical delivery synchronized.

Overhauled enterprise Angular application architecture with lazy-loaded Angular Router modules, Dependency Injection patterns, and standalone/feature boundaries—elevating Core Web Vitals, shrinking initial bundle size by 28%, and lowering bounce rates by 15%.

Delivered complex domain workflows with Angular Reactive Forms and React feature modules, template-driven form migration paths, and validation pipelines, while coordinating Agile sprints, backlog grooming, and iterative release planning with cross-functional stakeholders.

Implemented scalable client state and async data flows with RxJS operators, NgRx store/effects, and Angular Signals where appropriate, eliminating redundant HTTP round-trips and lifting checkout conversion by 18%.
Automated continuous integration and deployment with GitHub Actions and Docker, raising team release velocity and deployment frequency by 50% within Agile delivery cycles.
Directed a distributed engineering squad of 12 developers, governing architectural standards, pull-request quality gates, and agile sprint delivery for generative AI builder platforms.
Pioneered real-time streaming interfaces for generative AI application customization with React, Vue, WebSockets, and Tailwind CSS, driving a 60% increase in weekly active user retention.
Formulated automated regression testing pipelines and real-time telemetry utilizing Jest and Sentry, curbing production bug escapes by 42%.
Crafted scalable frontend architectures with React and Vue for 10+ client applications across social networking, marketplace commerce, and virtual meeting productivity tools.
Published an internal reusable component library featuring 50+ accessible React, Vue, and React Native primitives, curtailing multi-project feature build time by 30%.
Engineered resilient client-side authentication and state synchronization via Redux Toolkit, providing sub-100ms UI responsiveness across constrained network connections.
Spearheaded full-stack development of client web portals and Progressive Web Applications (PWA) using React, Next.js, and Node.js REST services, elevating active task completion rates by 28%.
Engineered Next.js server-side rendering (SSR) and Service Worker asset caching architectures, reducing First Contentful Paint (FCP) by 45% and elevating 30-day user retention by 20%.
Architected high-throughput MongoDB aggregation pipelines and indexing models, cutting database query execution latency by 38% across 15,000+ active mobile user accounts.

Engineered 12+ bespoke client web applications and responsive e-commerce storefronts using JavaScript, HTML5/SCSS, Node.js, and MySQL, achieving a 100% on-time project completion rate and a 5.0/5.0 client satisfaction rating.
Constructed reusable UI component templates and standardized cross-browser workflows, reducing subsequent client maintenance tickets by 35% and accelerating page load speeds by 25%.
Implemented structured SEO schemas and semantic DOM architectures across client landing pages, driving a 40% average increase in organic search traffic within 90 days of launch.
